scope: Current native detector-reading backlog; capability families and named fixture cases are not counts of unread acquired files. Preserve the full pinned FabIO target without treating every optional extension as a release blocker.

entries.title: HDF5 enum/compound image representations
entries.detail: Four authored cases complete in pinned FabIO and are rejected by the native exact-type contract. These are four fixture cases in one capability area; acquired-detector relevance is unestablished.

entries.title: NPY structured and string arrays
entries.detail: Two authored cases complete in pinned FabIO and are rejected by the native image dtype contract. String/record arrays are not ordinary numeric detector-count images.

entries.title: Additional HDF5/VDS storage and types
entries.detail: Cross-axis non-printf unlimited mappings, point selections, VDS concrete leaves using external raw storage, arbitrary custom types and native HDF5-2 complex types are outside qualified image contracts. Separate raw external windows and finite/nested/printf/frame-axis VDS are already supported.

entries.title: Additional original-JPEG TIFF profiles
entries.detail: Higher-precision/lossless processes, noncomplete subsampled planar streams, planar multiple strips/restarts and remaining ambiguous header/entropy partitions are unqualified. No current corpus blocker is demonstrated.

entries.title: Additional TIFF/JPEG/JPEG2000 layouts
entries.detail: Mixed TIFF sample representations/packed color and additional bit-order layouts; lossy JPEG above 8-bit/lossless multichannel above 8-bit; JPX/multiple codestreams/palettes/component mapping/subsampled JPEG2000 remain outside current contracts. Not all are supported by the pinned reference.

entries.title: Legacy MAR layouts
entries.detail: Raw/spiral/old IMAGE layouts and degenerate predictor shapes remain unsupported. PCK V1 and original V2 are implemented. An acquired V2 sample is a validation need, not another decoder implementation task.

entries.title: Additional SPE/MRC/DM3 layouts
entries.detail: Repeated SPE region blocks/additional XML layouts, MRC modes 12/101 and packed IMOD, DM3 packed/RGB/complex images and DM4 are optional extensions. Supported pinned MRC modes and explicit SPE regions/stacks are already qualified.

entries.title: Extended precision and obsolete EDF compression
entries.detail: EDF 128-bit labels need a verified source ABI; optional OFFSET needs an independent codec authority unavailable in the pinned environment. Arrays/volumes, exact types and available-span recovery are implemented.

entries.title: Platform-dependent NPY extended precision
entries.detail: 16-byte float interpretation is unavailable in the pinned macOS NumPy environment; no portable interpretation is asserted. Boolean, binary16 and empty arrays are implemented.

entries.title: Other legacy record/type variants
entries.detail: Additional HiPiC/Oxford/GE/Pixi/Bruker/R-AXIS/FIT2D/KCD layouts and binary/external MPA need concrete source examples before new decoding contracts are added. Explicit source records, readouts and derived views are already available.

entries.title: Additional XSData layouts
entries.detail: Other XML namespaces, ranks, type/coding combinations and nested array layouts are optional; the current explicit 2D numeric record contract remains bounded.

entries.title: Additional CBF decoding/section semantics
entries.detail: Other decoded conversions, multiple binary sections and dictionary semantics remain outside the integer single-section image API. CIF 1.1/2.0 syntax, Pilatus parsing and opaque encoded-byte access are implemented separately.

entries.title: Alternative sparse derived reconstructions
entries.detail: Stochastic noise/cutoff synthesis and Python-fallback semantics are separate optional derived models. Original stored events/components and explicit deterministic reconstruction are supported.

entries.title: Additional profile declarations
entries.detail: Unspecified CHIPLOT uncertainty/declaration variants remain unsupported; exact ASCII table/profile source tokens and numeric views are qualified.

entries.title: Missing counts and malformed input
entries.detail: Complete-image reads reject missing samples; explicit recovery exposes only available spans and integrity. Reference zero padding is not evidence for measured counts.

entries.title: Immutable sources and explicit manifests
entries.detail: Changed/growing sources require reopening. External links, relocated modules, printf prefixes and file series require explicit source contracts. Live/SWMR refresh and implicit neighboring-file search are separate product scope, not unfinished snapshot reading.

entries.title: Stored samples versus consumer views
entries.detail: Orientation, normalization, masks, reference display conversion, KCD sums, Bruker/R-AXIS expansion and sparse backgrounds stay explicit consumer/derived policies. TIFF float16 widening retains source precision metadata.

entries.title: No object deserialization or guessed declarations
entries.detail: Object NPY input is rejected without unpickling. Missing/unknown source type declarations are not guessed; explicit documented aliases remain accepted.

entries.title: Qualified reference defects and presentation
entries.detail: Pillow planar16 errors, HDF5 nested printf cache behavior, MAR dialect/predictor errors, MRC mode3 errors and CIF/header projection differences remain recorded; reproducing wrong source counts is not a native task.

entries.title: Rejected or undefined reference capabilities
entries.detail: Tested HDF5 producers reject genuinely infinite unions/unsupported cardinality changes and printf width tokens. Binary column tables are an upstream stub; pinned PNM P3/P4/P6/P7 are unimplemented. These are not demonstrated working FabIO capabilities to port.

entries.title: Python object/writer and integration APIs
entries.detail: Writing, in-place Python/h5py object mutation/identity, statistics and integration mathematics are outside this native input crate. Read-only frame/navigation/document/NeXus helpers have their own qualified contracts.

validation_batches.title: Acquired Eiger/LImA/Lambda scans
validation_batches.check: Complete first/middle/last and all-frame count hashes, source dtype/axes, needed acquisition fields, module/link manifests and frozen source checks. Extend beyond existing acquired Eiger benchmark and relocated Lambda corpus.

validation_batches.title: Acquired TIFF/CBF/EDF detector images and stacks
validation_batches.check: Original counts, reserved/saturated values, orientation metadata, compression, frame enumeration and required geometry/header fields. Include original files rather than only writer-generated variants.

validation_batches.title: Acquired legacy detector files
validation_batches.check: MAR345/MAR555 V1 are covered; seek an acquired V2 if available. Add actual SPE ROI/frame metadata, DM3 main-image selection and legacy detector examples needed by consumers.

validation_batches.title: Acquired sparse frames with nonempty events
validation_batches.check: Existing acquired sparse file has zero events. Validate source event words and metadata on nonempty acquisitions before extending derived models.

validation_batches.title: Consumer-required acquisition semantics
validation_batches.check: Name the geometry, wavelength, distance, exposure, detector identity and timestamp fields actually required. Retain units/raw values and compare them on acquired files; unknown vendor metadata is a requirement/validation question, not a counted decoder defect.

validation_batches.title: Deployment and consumer read workflows
validation_batches.check: Validate required feature combinations on target platforms, stream/series/source-replacement behavior and the agreed reader API. Application migration stays a separate authorized task.
